authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Govt of India
benefit: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection + Free hotplate (gas stove) + First 14.2 kg LPG refill free + ₹300 per cylinder DBT subsidy

criteria.label: Adult age eligibility check (18 years or older)
criteria.plain_description: The woman applicant must have attained at least 18 years of age.
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar Card or Voter ID proving age 18 years or above.

criteria.label: Deprived / BPL / Antyodaya household category qualification
criteria.plain_description: Applicant must belong to poor rural/urban household holding BPL/AAY/PHH Ration Card or SC/ST category.
criteria.remediation: Provide valid Ration Card or BPL certificate.

criteria.label: Aadhaar e-KYC and seeded bank account for targeted subsidy
criteria.plain_description: Aadhaar is mandatory for deduplication across all Oil Marketing Companies (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL).

application.office_name: Nearest LPG Gas Distributor Agency (Indane / Bharat Gas / HP Gas)
documents_to_carry: Aadhaar card of applicant and all adult family members
Bank Account Passbook showing IFSC and active status
Self-declaration for supplementary migrant address if applicable
process_steps: Apply online on PMUY portal or submit physical form to local LPG gas agency
Agency performs national deduplication to ensure no existing connection exists in household
Security deposit waiver approved by Oil Marketing Company (OMC)
Gas stove, regulator, pipe, and first filled cylinder issued free of cost
